🏥 Nearly 3,000 people a day were treated in hospital CORRIDORS in England last month.

Not on a ward. Not in a side room. In corridors — a setting the NHS itself classifies as not clinically appropriate or safe.

The new figures also show:
• A record 7.27 million A&E attendances over the summer
• 111,379 people waiting more than a year for treatment
• A target to get year-long waits below 1% missed by half again

I've also set out what got BETTER — cancer times and ambulance response times both improved — because you deserve the full picture, not just the bits that suit my argument.

👉 Judge the NHS by whether your mum gets a bed, not by whether a minister gets a soundbite.
